meta.title: Grid-Connection-Aware Scheduling of AI Data Centres with Green Hydrogen and Quantum-Assisted Workload Placement
meta.note: Hourly series are the MILP solutions of the independent Python reference model. The scenario table is read verbatim from data/research_results_gridflex.csv. The benchmark is a deterministic synthetic week, not operator data.

datasets.description: Candidate public datasets for a future real-data study. NONE of them is connected to, downloaded by, or used by this software; the published results come only from the synthetic benchmark in this folder. Licences and access terms were checked against the providers' own pages on the date shown. Re-check terms before any use.
